description: This file implements functions for creating, initializing, enrolling objects, and removing a diagnostic tracing object specific to the BBHM model. It defines the core object lifecycle functions for a module related to IP traceroute diagnostics within a home management system.

classes.name: BBHM_TRACERT_TDO_OBJECT
classes.description: The main object representing the Trace Route Diagnostic IP TDO, containing configuration parameters and function pointers for its operations.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE BbhmDiagitTdoCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a new Trace Route Diagnostic IP TDO object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BbhmDiagitTdoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the specified TDO object, freeing resources.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BbhmDiagitTdoEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls subordinate or related objects necessary for the TDO functionality.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BbhmDiagitTdoInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the TDO object, setting default values and function pointers.
